archetype: The Performance Pro / Industrial Command Center

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look) with 1px border-border/40, flat backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders to separate elements. No soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay to break digital flatness, maintaining an industrial matte finish.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges, max rounded-sm (2px) or completely square (rounded-none).

grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment, text left-aligned for data readability.

components.buttons: Square or slight radius, flat color or 1px border. Hover states use slight brightness increase.
components.cards: Cardless aesthetic. Use simple divs with border-b border-r and flat backgrounds. Never use default rounded-xl Shadcn cards.
components.forms: Use Shadcn inputs but remove heavy border radius. Use JetBrains Mono for input text.
components.headers: Solid background (#121212) with hard bottom border. Never use transparent background.

motion.hover: Instant color shift or 1px translation. No long fades.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratio. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='recall-engine-button').
accessibility.focus: High-contrast amber focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FFB000] focus:outline-none

images.description: A dramatic offshore oil rig brilliantly lit against the nighttime sky.

specific_pages.dashboard: Leaflet map taking central prominence. KPIs flanked on the sides.
specific_pages.case_library: Dense data tables, minimal padding in cells. JetBrains mono for metrics.
specific_pages.recall_engine: Split view: New event parameters vs top matching historical cases. Use color coding (amber) to highlight matches.
specific_pages.evidence_viewer: Multi-pane view. Sensor traces in Recharts, logs text-heavy in monospace.
specific_pages.conflict_detection: Warning indicators (Signal Red) for contradictory evidence. Side-by-side comparison.
specific_pages.ai_assistant: Floating or docked side panel, distinct background (#121212) to separate from data widgets.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: You have .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write all code, including React components, using .jsx or .js extension semantics.
Configure Tailwind with the specified colors and fonts (Chivo, JetBrains Mono). Include font imports in HTML/CSS.
Use Shadcn UI but override border radii to be 0 or 2px to maintain the industrial workstation feel.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdowns MUST have a solid background like #121212.
Implement routing (e.g., react-router-dom) so clicking any features navigates to the respective pages.
Ensure the dashboard uses a dense, technical layout without excessive empty space.
Use realistic mock data for drilling parameters (e.g., ROP, Mud Weight, Depth, Kicks, Stuck Pipe).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered z-index hierarchy, not soft shadows.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use square or sharp buttons to match the industrial style.
Never use AI assistant emojis (like robot or brain).
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic by ensuring components look purpose-built, raw, and functional.
